PRCY0001 Precyos daily BTC price series
UTF-8 plain text
Each record: best available BTC/USD price for that date
Days with no price are omitted
Fields:
TAG=format version ("PRCY0001" means the first format schema, "PRCY0002" the second. Each format change will be announced in the weekly price posts.)
PAIR=base/quote (1 BTC = X USD: 1 Bitcoin to X United States Dollars. Prices are shown in USD per 1 BTC.)
TIME=sample time (00:00 UTC, planet Earth, Sol system)
RECORDS=YYYYMMDD=price in quote currency, one per line
